City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
May 16, 2011
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificate of Appreciation to South Bay Lions Club for donation of Cherry trees.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: April 27 and May 2
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting resolution calling for a General Municipal Election on November 8, 2011 for the purpose of electing two officers to the Lomita City Council and resolution requesting the County of Los Angeles Elections Department to render specified election services. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
e.
Report recommending purchase of a Water Valve Turning Maintenance Machine in the amount of $27,575. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
f.
Report recommending Award of Consultant Services Contract ($59,250) to Kennedy/Jenks Consultants to conduct a Feasibility Analysis for Cypress Reservoir and Water Production Facility. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report recommending allocation of $350,000 from the Street Improvement Fund for slurry seal projects on various streets within the City and to authorize staff to prepare the bid documents and advertise the project. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report recommending approval of a purchase order for the sole source purchase of budgeted replacement water meters. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS Appointments for vacancies on the Planning Commission (2), Public Safety and Traffic Commission (2), Railroad Museum Board (2), Railroad Museum Foundation (3) and Tree Commission (2).
7.
HIRING FREEZE Discussion and possible action on instituting a hiring freeze until the contract with the Lomita City Employees Association is approved. Requested by Councilmember Traina.
8.
TIM KING MEMORIAL Discussion and possible action on the placement of a memorial to former Councilmember Tim King.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
9.
SCHEDULE MEETING DATES Selection of meeting dates to hold a budget study session and public hearing as well as an economic development meeting.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
10.
CYPRESS STREET RESERVOIR Report presenting update on status of Cypress Street Reservoir, Treatment Plant and Well # 5.
Presented by Public Works Director Damasse.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
